facts.title: shadcn/ui - The Foundation for your Design System
facts.description: Composable, accessible components with thoughtful defaults. Build your own component library with code you can customize, extend, and make your own.

research.name: shadcn/ui
research.note: Accessible React components you copy into your own codebase through a CLI and registry, the base of many collections.

effects: Copy-into-your-repo distribution through the shadcn CLI and an open registry format

unverified: The source is in the public repository shadcn-ui/ui (MIT); that repository has not been researched yet.
The visual components themselves are ordinary; the listed signature is a distribution idea, not a visual effect.
